market.question: Will the highest temperature in Miami be between 92-93°F on May 9?

assessment.reasoning: Forecasts for Miami on Saturday May 9, 2026 cluster at a high near 92°F (NWS area forecast and weathershogun, sunny/breezy, low rain chance). Market resolves Yes if rounded high is 92°F or 93°F. With same-day NWS bias of ±1-2°F, probability the high lands in the 92-93°F bucket is meaningful — perhaps 40-45%. Key risks: actual high prints 91°F or 94°F.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether peak observed at KMIA station is 91°F (one degree off) or pops to 94°F under stronger sun.
